title: WOLF production plan
about: Everything WOLF is and will be, in order. Status: done, active, next, later, idea. 'who' says whether the owner (human), Claude (claude), or either is needed.

phases.name: 1. Foundation
phases.goal: A personal assistant that remembers you between conversations.

items.title: Decide what WOLF is
items.note: A personal AI assistant that learns along with its owner over time.

items.title: Long-term memory: profile, memories, journal
items.note: Plain, editable files in ~/.wolf, never in the project.

items.title: Save what was learned at the end of each conversation
Development assistant for building WOLF
items.note: wolf-dev, Claude Code skills, knowledge base.

phases.name: 2. Talk to WOLF anywhere
phases.goal: Use WOLF from a phone or computer, by typing or speaking.

items.title: Web app for phone and desktop
Voice: speak to WOLF and hear replies
items.note: Needs https on phones (Tailscale or hosting).

phases.name: 3. Building blocks
phases.goal: Make WOLF easy to extend, and make the project easy for people and AI to work on together.

items.title: Swappable components (memory, web search, clock, your own)
Project hub: this plan, a research forum, build progress
Friendlier app: tab bar, suggestions, ability switches, help
Clearer layout: Chat, Schedule, Memory, Settings
items.note: Owner found the old tabs confusing; project plan and forum moved off the main tabs.

phases.name: 4. Real-world check
phases.goal: Confirm everything works on the owner's own devices with a real Claude key.

items.title: First real conversation with Claude
items.note: Needs the owner's API key; Claude can't do this from the cloud sandbox.

items.title: Try the microphone and spoken replies on a real device

phases.name: 5. Personality
phases.goal: Give WOLF a character of its own instead of a generic assistant voice.

items.title: Owner shares the personality ("MONTY")
items.note: The setting is ready: write MONTY under You, Personality, Your own, or describe it in the forum.

items.title: Make the personality a swappable setting
items.note: Presets (Balanced, Coach, Calm, Playful, Brief) or your own words; pick on the You tab. MONTY can go in as 'your own'.

phases.name: 6. Learn from your life
phases.goal: WOLF learns from where the owner's life already lives, with permission.

items.title: Calendar component (read-only first)
items.note: Read-only, any service via its private iCal link; connect on the You tab.

phases.name: 7. Proactive help
phases.goal: WOLF reaches out: reminders, check-ins, weekly goal reviews.

items.title: Pick where WOLF runs all the time
Reminders and check-ins
items.note: WOLF sets reminders when asked; due ones show above the chat and at the start of each conversation.

phases.name: Ideas (not scheduled)
phases.goal: Worth discussing in the forum before planning.

items.title: Swappable model backend, including a local model
Smarter memory search once memory grows
Talk to WOLF from a messaging app
